title: Willowbrook Volunteer Fire Department Staffing Shortage Crisis

scenario.title: Willowbrook Volunteer Fire Department Staffing Shortage Crisis
scenario.setting: The quiet rural town of Willowbrook’s volunteer fire department gathers in its scuffed concrete fire hall. An overflowing ashtray sits next to a whiteboard marked with 12 empty first responder shifts over the next four days. Local farmers and shop owners have begun sharing urgent shift-swap requests across the town’s only community Facebook group.

characters.name: Jessa
characters.tendencies: She systematically counts available volunteers, supply stocks, and unmet shifts to identify critical gaps

characters.name: Tomas
characters.tendencies: He raises loud, public alarms about the staffing shortage to pressure townsfolk into stepping up to volunteer

characters.name: Lila
characters.tendencies: She is a trainee learning department protocols and organizing small temporary fixes for the staffing shortfall

turns.name: Jessa
turns.text:
I’ve counted 12 confirmed volunteer firefighters signed on so far, leaving a four-person shortfall for the overnight brush patrol shift. Our first-aid supply bins are overflowing with bandages and antiseptic, but we’re down to only three pairs of reinforced fire gloves and a single extra hose coupling. We need to put out a quick call to the adjacent county fire department to borrow the remaining gear we need.
[Bending over a smudged metal clipboard tucked under one arm, marking a bold red “CRITICAL” next to the listed gear shortage on her tally sheet]

turns.name: Tomas
turns.text:
"Folks, gather ‘round—last night’s barn fire call pushed our entire volunteer crew to the breaking point, and we’re operating with barely a quarter of our needed staff right now. I won’t stand by while we put our town’s safety at risk because no one wants to volunteer a few hours a month. We need bodies on the roster, and we need them now."
[Slams a stack of dog-eared volunteer sign-up sheets hard against the scuffed concrete firehall counter, jabbing a finger at the empty driver’s seat of the nearest fire engine bay.]

turns.name: Lila
turns.text:
I’ve rounded up three local teen volunteers who completed our mandatory safety refresher course to cover the open shift slots left by the crew dispatched to the Route 7 barn fire. I left a stack of post-incident debrief forms on the back counter by the percolator for anyone who wants to fill them out after their shifts.
[She shifts her scuffed training clipboard under one arm and nods toward the two nervous-looking teens hovering near the fire bay entrance, waiting to be oriented to station roles.]

turns.name: Jessa
turns.text:
That’s such a huge help—those three teen volunteers cover three of the four overnight brush patrol spots we were short. I just need to track down one last volunteer to fill that final gap and cross-check our first-aid supplies to make sure we’ve got enough for the shift.
[She scribbles a quick note marking the remaining open patrol slot on the scuffed fire hall whiteboard before grabbing a clipboard to inventory the emergency medical stockpile.]

turns.name: Tomas
turns.text: "Last night’s barn fire pushed our volunteer crew to the breaking point, and we’re still one person short for the overnight brush patrol even with those three teen trainees filling some slots. We can’t leave Willowbrook’s rural roads and brushlands unprotected tonight—every single person who can lend a hand needs to step up right now. Don’t wait until it’s too late to do your part for the town you call home." [Slams a palm against the side of a nearby fire engine to draw everyone’s eyes, then gestures sharply at the tattered volunteer sign-up sheet tacked to the wall]

turns.name: Lila
turns.text:
I rounded up the three teen volunteers who finished our mandatory safety refresher and had them wait by the brush truck in the fire bay. I’ve already printed out the overnight patrol checklists and marked the high-risk dry brush zones they need to monitor closely.
[Setting a stack of neatly stapled checklists and a spare portable radio on the scuffed concrete table before gesturing toward the waiting teens.]

dm_opening: DM opening: the cast gathers around a question the scene has been carrying for a year.
dm_closing: DM closing: the Jessa holds the line; the next session's hook waits at the door.
